summary: Tested executive analytics baseline backend + mobile web UI. Core filters/dashboard/funnel/products/exports work, but brand detail endpoint fails with 500 and brand drill-down UI breaks. Also found React Native web console errors from raw text nodes inside table cells.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error. Traceback shows dashboard() called with positional args causing `user` to become a FastAPI Depends object (`'Depends' object has no attribute 'role'`).

minor.issue: Public preview host had intermittent auth/login read timeouts during pytest runs (flaky network during test setup).
Could not validate happy-path due empty referrer data in current environment (`filters.referrers` and `dashboard.referrals` empty).

ui_bugs.component: Brand drill-down from Executive > Brand performance table
ui_bugs.issue: Navigates to /sales-data/brands/{id} but renders ErrorState: 'Could not load brand analytics' due backend 500.

integration_issues.flow: Executive analytics brand row tap -> brand detail fetch

react_native_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs 'Unexpected text node ... cannot be a child of <View>' indicating raw string children rendered in View hierarchy (Text wrapping issue).

action_items: Fix brand_detail route call to dashboard() using keyword args (pass user=user explicitly at correct parameter).
Retest brand detail API and UI drill-down after fix.
Fix table rendering so all cell text is wrapped with <Text> (or TableCell internally wraps primitive strings).
Re-run executive analytics pytest suite once network is stable to remove flaky timeout noise.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/executive_analytics_routes.py line ~174 uses positional args when calling dashboard(), causing parameter shift and runtime 500.
frontend executive table cells pass plain strings/numbers as children to View-based TableCell; this violates React Native text wrapping rules and produces runtime console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stable run confirmed filters/dashboard/funnel/products/exports and customer/salesperson detail routes. Main blocking defect is brand detail 500. Referrer happy-path was not testable due empty referrer dataset in this environment.
rca_of_issue: Repro: login as owner -> GET /api/executive-analytics/dashboard (pick first brand_id) -> GET /api/executive-analytics/brands/{brand_id} => 500. Backend traceback shows `brand_detail` calls `dashboard()` positionally, shifting args so `user` remains Depends placeholder, leading to `AttributeError: 'Depends' object has no attribute 'role'` in accessible_floor_ids(). UI impact: Executive brand row opens Brand analytics screen but shows ErrorState. Mitigation: call dashboard with named args to preserve parameter binding; then rerun API + UI drilldown tests.
